newsitem.title: LEBANON: Six charged with embezzlement in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: Six charged with embezzlement in Beirut.

text.p: A Lebanese prosecutor charged six people on Monday with embezzling some 15 billion Lebanese pounds from the sale of forged and genuine revenue stamps, judicial sources said.
They included two employees of the Finance Ministry, which issues the stamps which must be put on documents in official transactions.
Two of the six were still at large, including junior Finance Ministry official Ra'afat Sleiman, who is responsible for the sale of the stamps.
If convicted, the six face up to five years in jail.
